_comment: Pinned SG13G2 PDK revision this sim/ tree's committed evidence records were generated against. Every record under sim/*/records/*.md must trace to this file (or a later commit that bumps it) -- see sim/README.md 'PDK pin' section. Not consumed by tooling; kept as a plain, greppable fact sheet. Follows sg13g2-bandgap/sim/pdk.json's and sg13g2-opamp/sim/pdk.json's shape (same PDK, same pinned release).
pdk_root_layout: PDK_ROOT/ihp-sg13g2 (open_pdks-shaped install, klt pdk find/list convention)

device_models_used_by_this_repo_so_far._comment: sim/hbt-characterization/ (issue #7) is the first sim/ experiment in this repo, and it only instantiates npn13G2 -- a native ngspice VBIC (level=9) bipolar model, NOT a Verilog-A/OSDI-compiled device. Unlike sg13g2-bandgap and sg13g2-opamp (both of which instantiate PSP103 MOS and/or r3_cmc resistor devices that require the OSDI compile step -- see those repos' sim/tools/build-osdi.sh), this experiment needs no OSDI toolchain at all: `.lib "cornerHBT.lib" <section>` plus a bare `ngspice -b` invocation is sufficient. A future sim/ experiment in this repo that instantiates sg13_lv_mos/sg13_hv_mos or a resistor WILL need an OSDI build step -- port sim/tools/build-osdi.sh from sg13g2-bandgap or sg13g2-opamp when that need arises, rather than inventing a new one.
device_models_used_by_this_repo_so_far.npn13G2: native VBIC (Rev. 1.15, level=9) SPICE model card, sg13g2_hbt_mod.lib -- loaded directly via cornerHBT.lib's .LIB sections, no compile step
